messages:
Maya: quick ping — PR #2456 is green locally but CI is failing on windows-smoke::RenderCacheTest (flaky assertion). @Sam can you take a look? https://ci.redwood.example/builds/112233 :eyes:
ci-bot: build #112233 failed on job windows-smoke (exit 1)
Sam: on it. will queue a targeted rerun on the smoke shard. I saw a similar flake last week on Win + AVX-compat.
Maya: thanks. attaching the failing stack (trimmed):
```
AssertionError: expected cache size 1024 got 0
at RenderCacheTest.populateCache (render_cache_test.cpp:123)
at RenderCacheTest.TestBody (render_cache_test.cpp:78)
```
Jon: hmm looks like a race where the setup didn't finish before the assert. timeout or flaky fixture. Can you try a targeted rerun for shard=win-smoke-2 and also add `--collect-logs` to the rerun so we get full machine logs?
Maya: doing `/ci retry --target shard=win-smoke-2 --collect-logs` now. queued as rerun #112234.
ci-bot: rerun #112234 started on win-smoke-2
ci-bot: rerun #112234 failed again — same assertion (captured logs at https://ci.redwood.example/builds/112234/logs).
Claire: if it's reproducing on rerun I'd prefer we hold the merge. Snapshot update won't help here. Might be an infra flake or a test order dependency. @Sam can infra verify node health for win-smoke-2?
Sam: will check node health and taint history. quick check: node had a recent kernel update 2 days ago, but other jobs on that node passed. I'll spin a rerun on shard win-smoke-4 as cross-check.
Maya: queued rerun on win-smoke-4 as #112235.
ci-bot: rerun #112235 passed ✅
Jon: ok cross-shard pass is encouraging. I'm fine approving conditional merge if we get one more clean run on the original shard or a green canary deploy.
Maya: thanks — can I get approvals from @Jon and @Claire to merge if we get one more green on win-smoke-2? I'll wait for one more rerun and then merge during the next window. :crossed_fingers:
Jon: approved pending one more green rerun.
Claire: approved to merge after confirmatory pass on win-smoke-2 (or if infra root cause found).
Maya: queued final rerun on win-smoke-2 as #112236 with `--collect-logs`. ci-bot said it's started.
ci-bot: rerun #112236 passed ✅ — no failures observed.
Maya: merging now. thanks everyone for quick responses :rocket:
Sam: thanks — I'll follow up with infra to check the node from earlier and file a ticket if we see recurring flakes.
Maya: noted — created infra ticket INFRA-789 and linked logs.
